livePatchReview.scope: Read-only comparison of GitHub PR patches with the current migration. The pinned snapshot below is unchanged. No additional PR has been applied in this pass.
livePatchReview.8304: Patch retrieved. Preserve the existing split-editor downscroll/Vortex implementation; compare remaining grid, waveform and event positioning with native tests before adding overlapping changes.
livePatchReview.8374: Applicable: PasteItemsCommand.undo removes the pasted notes, then SelectItemsCommand appends restored notes without discarding the obsolete selection. Needs native paste/undo/flip regression.
livePatchReview.8315: Applicable with adaptation: playVocals still decides legacy fallback from the requested ID count rather than actual available audio. Preserve explicit legacyVoiceId overrides and typed asset resolution when integrating.
livePatchReview.8394: Patch retrieved. Cross-cutting clock and judgement changes are deferred until reproducible frame-rate timing checks exist; keep the pinned Conductor behavior.
livePatchReview.8402: Wrapper-only refactor: getFileStat still throws if a recent chart or backup disappears. Review the intended missing-file behavior and sandbox wrapper before integrating.
livePatchReview.8384: Candidate: live patch now includes cursor down/up events and a chart playbar reset; the snapshot listed one changed file. Confirm the revision and test input priority and touch behavior before applying.
livePatchReview.8343: Existing source already has measured character bounds, preview positioning/padding and title-height sizing. Do not replace the pinned flixel-animate revision with the older PR pin. Native preview validation pending.
livePatchReview.8397: Not a direct port: LuaSlice keeps enabled mod IDs in its save on desktop and mobile; this PR only gates upstream enabled.txt access to desktop.
livePatchReview.8398: Existing source uses both the loading-character directory and JSON suffix filters. No duplicate patch needed.
livePatchReview.8399: Existing editor state has zero-volume unmute restoration for metronome, hitsounds, vocals and instrumental. Verify editor controls natively before claiming complete parity.
